pages.text: $(thing)Nucleosynthesis$()$(br2)Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Stellar Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 White Dwarf Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the energy (MeV) released when four hydrogen atoms fuse into one helium-4 atom (atomic masses in u, 1 u = 931.5 MeV).
